title: Put toys in the bin

steps.tip: Put the bin on the floor where you can reach it.

steps.text: Pick up toys one at a time.
steps.tip: Look under the bed and around the pillows too.

steps.text: Drop each toy in the bin.
steps.tip: Soft toys and blocks can share the same bin.

done_when: Toy bin is in its usual spot
parent_notes: Good first daily chore. Stay nearby for ages 4–6.
